title.zh: 将达瑙市Looc小学的名称正式变更为Bibiana Mercado小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Looc Elementary School in the City of Danao to Bibiana Mercado Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Looc Elementary School in the City of Danao to Bibiana Mercado Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Looc tại Thành phố Danao thành Trường tiểu học Bibiana Mercado
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Looc ในเมือง Danao เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Bibiana Mercado
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Looc di Kota Danao menjadi Sekolah Dasar Bibiana Mercado
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Looc di Bandaraya Danao menjadi Sekolah Rendah Bibiana Mercado

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5614_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Looc Elementary School in the City of Danao is hereby changed to Bibiana Mercado Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
